test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 10th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

C _ P _ _ M _ K C M P _ C M _ K

options.text: M K C P K P
M K M P K P
P K C P K P
M K C M K C

solution:
Given sequence: C _ P _ _ M _ K C M P _ C M _ K

 
• M K C P K P → C **M** P **K** - **C** M **P** K - C M P **K** - C M **P** K
 
• M K M P K P → C **M** P **K - M** M **P** K - C M P **K** - C M
